# Design point P004

## Description

The system distributes repositories as packfiles for scalable Git access while periodically compacting repository and log storage to bound restore and lookup costs. Replica health is assessed using both heartbeat signals and failures observed in real application traffic, informing repair, isolation, or bypass decisions.
